info.name: POS Platform API
info.description: Universal Retail Business Management Platform - backend JSON API (posbd). Organized by domain module; new modules (products, inventory, billing, ...) get their own folder as they're built. Auth uses a Bearer token returned by register/login; tenant-scoped requests also need the `x-business-id` header, set automatically by the 'Create Business' request's test script.

item.name: Categories
item.description: Tenant-scoped: every request here requires the x-business-id header (set automatically once you run Businesses > Create Business).

item.name: Products
item.description: Tenant-scoped: every request here requires the x-business-id header.

item.name: Attributes
item.description: Tenant-scoped, read-only: attributes/values are created implicitly via Product Variant create/update.

item.name: Pricing
item.description: Tenant-scoped. A price tier belongs to exactly one of a product (product_id) or a variant (variant_id); price_tiers/quote resolves the applicable unit price for a given quantity/date, the same lookup Billing will use later.

item.name: Quote Price (resolve unit price for a quantity)
Inventory
item.description: Tenant-scoped. Every stock change goes through POST /inventory/movements - opening stock is just a movement with movement_type=opening_stock. Stock is never edited directly.

item.name: Customers
item.description: Tenant-scoped. List/Show responses now include each customer's purchase stats (total_spent, visit_count, last_purchase_at, outstanding_balance) and computed segment (vip/high_value/regular/new/inactive - Phase 2 §15/§16/§22/§33), derived fresh from their invoices rather than stored.

item.name: Get Customer Purchase Summary
item.description: Total spend, visits, last purchase, average bill, outstanding balance, top products, and segment for one customer.

item.name: Billing
item.description: Tenant-scoped. POST /invoices computes all pricing/tax/discount server-side from product_id/variant_id + quantity - never send a price. Passing the same idempotency_key twice returns the original invoice instead of creating a duplicate.

item.name: Create Invoice (registered customer, with discount + partial payment)
Record Additional Payment (settle a partial/credit sale)
Reports
item.description: Tenant-scoped, read-only. from/to are inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates in the business's own timezone.

item.name: Bulk Import
item.description: Tenant-scoped. Two-step flow: POST .../preview (multipart file upload) validates every row without writing anything and returns per-row errors; POST .../commit (JSON) takes back exactly the rows you choose to keep (the 'fields' from each valid preview row, plus its row_number) and creates them. Products/opening stock are scoped to simple (non-variant) products for now. Historical Bills rows are grouped by invoice_number into one invoice per group and never touch inventory - run Products and Opening Stock first so every SKU already exists.

item.name: Audit Logs
item.description: Tenant-scoped, read-only. Requires the 'audit.view' permission (owner/admin only). Records product created/updated/price-changed/deleted, business settings updated, invoice created/cancelled, manual stock adjustments, and bulk imports performed. Filterable by action, entity_type, and from/to (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive).

item.name: Subscription (Phase 2)
item.description: The business's own view of its SaaS subscription - completely separate from retail billing/payments. 'List Public Plans' needs no auth (used on the marketing/signup pages before an account exists); the rest are tenant-scoped and are never blocked by the subscription gate, so a business whose trial/subscription has lapsed can still see why and fix it.

item.name: Create Checkout Order
item.description: Requires 'settings.manage'. Creates a Razorpay Order and returns {order_id, key_id, amount, currency} for the frontend to open Razorpay Checkout with.

item.name: Verify Checkout
item.description: Verifies the HMAC-SHA256 signature Razorpay Checkout's success handler returns, then activates the subscription. Only callable with real values from an actual Razorpay Checkout session - not directly testable from Postman.

item.name: Razorpay Webhook (reference only)
item.description: Called directly by Razorpay, not by a client. No user auth - authenticated instead by the X-Razorpay-Signature header, an HMAC-SHA256 of the exact raw request body using the webhook secret configured in the Razorpay dashboard. Idempotent (Phase 2 §11): the same event id is only ever processed once. Not usefully callable from Postman since the signature must match this exact body byte-for-byte.

item.name: Platform Admin (Phase 2)
item.description: Internal platform-operator API - a completely separate auth domain from tenant users (its own bearer token, never the business 'auth_token'). No self-registration; admin accounts are created out-of-band (seeds/console). 'admin' role can activate plans/cancel subscriptions/manage plans; 'support' role is read-only.
